inventory_status: Bookkeeping schema only; not an authoritative post-Goal-7 total.

trusted_base.rule: 64842 already includes the 12 prescreen-added episodes; do not add 12 again. Reset-only and synthetic checks are separate from full test episodes.

inventory.dedup_rule: Count each checkpoint summary JSON once. Exclude paired *_episodes.npz and *_traces.npz, result.json curve copies, suite summaries, plots, and historical reused results outside goal7.
inventory.extra_dedup_rule: Count each as separate seed-789 500-test evaluation; exclude paired NPZ and other summary copies.

inventory.dedup_rule: Count each checkpoint JSON once, including 256 intermediate tests and final 500 test; exclude result.json curve copies and paired NPZs.
inventory.reference_dedup_rule: Count the two partial condition JSONs once each (500, seed 456). Exclude confirmation_baseline.json wrapper, which duplicates them.
inventory.extra_tests_count_rule: Count each extra_ceiling JSON as an independent seed-789 500-test evaluation when present; exclude paired NPZs and result.json copies.

inventory.dedup_rule: Count newly collected intermediate 256-test seed-123 traces once via test_summary.json. If the JSON sidecar is absent, use the paired test_traces.npz episode_success array length as the sole source. Exclude analysis.json, summary*.json, probability_model.json and final point-0200 reuse of Goal 7 trace.

inventory.episode_field: episode_success array episode-axis length; paired JSON has episodes
inventory.dedup_rule: Count each distinct trace once: before repeat and each generated after pose repeat are 500 tests. Prefer paired JSON episodes when present; otherwise count NPZ episode_success entries. Never count trace and sidecar twice. Exclude failures.json after_per_seed/after_pooled (reused confirmation tests) and video_manifest.json pose_repeat_summaries (references same repeats).

inventory.reference_dedup_rule: Count each 500-test seed-123 partial condition JSON once per policy. Exclude baseline.json wrapper and NPZs.
inventory.training_dedup_rule: Count each checkpoint JSON and any extra_ceiling JSON once. Exclude result.json curve copies, suite summaries and paired NPZs.

inventory.phase: Goal 11 references, transfers and fresh training
inventory.reference_dedup_rule: Count floor and oracle once per problem (500, seed 123). Exclude baseline.json/result.json wrappers; the ceiling is copied from Goal 1 and is not new.
inventory.dedup_rule: Count each transfer JSON, checkpoint JSON and any extra_ceiling JSON once; exclude result wrappers, paired NPZs, suite summaries, and copied Goal 1 ceiling.

known_synthetic_only_checks.note: Recorded separately from 32 integration contract tests and the 12 full-test episodes already included in the trusted total.

known_synthetic_only_checks.count_basis: normal plus eight PROBLEMS parameter cases, delay, and oracle cases in test_camera.py; exit record itself does not contain pytest case count. Two parametrized integration probes were excluded.

deduplication_principles: Count the underlying measurement once using its designated summary JSON, or the unique trace array as fallback, never both.
Exclude wrappers/aggregates such as result.json, failures.json, baseline.json, suite summaries and plot summaries when they copy or aggregate measurements.
Later reuse of earlier tests is not a new measurement.
Keep full test episodes, reset-only probes and synthetic-only checks in separate counters.
